Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 20s goddess, legendary bust physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her upper body so wide; a mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her entire silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders and projecting well forward of the rest of her body, the single defining feature of her frame, every other curve secondary to it; below it a waistline still draws in with a visible inward pull, round hips and soft thighs continue her curves; her head looks small in comparison to her massive bust; the bust is unmistakably, overwhelmingly the dominant feature; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, long wavy balayage hair — wearing a skin-tight micro school uniform set, a bralette top of ultra-thin matte crisp white modal jersey with thin straps, fine white lace edging along the cups and a small burgundy ribbon bow at the center of its neckline, her shoulders and arms bare, the front closed by a short hidden zipper and the two sides of the modal jersey fully covering her bust, her whole ribcage, midriff and stomach bare below it, and a micro pleated skirt of ultra-thin matte burgundy modal jersey with a thin gold stripe along the hem, sitting at the top of her hip bones with the hem ending just below her hip bones. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small mole near her collarbone and a small beauty mark near her lips. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin modal jersey molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the soft matte drape of the white modal jersey against her bare shoulders and the crisp pleats of the skirt, fine stretch lines and a soft powdery matte finish. Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, platform stiletto ballet boots made of glossy burgundy leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.

Background: a real famous place photographed at true scale, Paris with the Eiffel Tower, the River Seine with its stone bridges and rows of cream stone buildings placed in the foreground close to the camera at the bottom centre of the frame, rising only to the height of her waist and thighs, tiny tourists, tiny cars and tiny tour buses around its base at their real size appearing as small as ants; she is a colossal giant standing just behind and slightly to one side of the foreground landmark, so that it overlaps only part of her legs and clearly shows how much taller than it she is, her towering heels planted on the riverside avenues, a soft golden-hour sky behind her, the whole place clearly visible and in focus, lit by warm golden-hour sunlight with gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at knee height, the famous foreground landmark large at the bottom centre of the frame and she standing just behind it, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the real people, vehicles and trees around her ankles shown at their true size so her colossal height and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph.
